summary: Purpose: materialize exactly one declared future RED test without starting Quick Dev; supports W0-W6 templates with TWR identifiers covering typed hashes, stale continuation, coverage gaps, knowledge gates, current-pointer integrity, retention approval, and end-to-end migration; reads implementation-contract.v1.json and requires known slice_id; selector must be a planned new file and allowed test change; snapshot_paths must equal the single selector; plan must reside under repository execution-plans; target must be relative, remain inside repository root, and exclude logs/execution-plans segments; existing identical test is accepted idempotently, conflicting content is rejected; absent parent directories and test are created with UTF-8 LF content; CLI requires repository root, plan directory, slice ID, snapshot path, and materialize-only flag; success emits materialized status, slice ID, POSIX target path, and empty authorizations.
